text: CRC Bluesky Limited holds all the voting shares in China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited; CRC Bluesky is a wholly owned subsidiary of China Resources Inc., of which China Resources Company Limited holds substantially all the shares; and China's SASAC and the National Council for Social Security Fund perform the duty of investor (as to 90.0222% and 9.9778%, respectively) of China Resources Company Limited on behalf of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.
short: China's SASAC performs the investor duty for China Resources Company Limited (90.0222%) on behalf of the State Council.

source.name: Oatly Group AB — Annual Report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR), Item 7.A, footnote (1)
source.quote: perform the duty of investor (as to 90.0222% and 9.9778%, respectively) of China Resources Company Limited on behalf of the State Council
source.note: Same footnote also states: 'CRC Bluesky Limited holds all the voting shares in China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited' and 'China Resources Company Limited holds substantially all the shares in China Resources Inc.'

additionalSources.name: Forbes (Carlton Reid) — The Malmö District Turning Industrial Ruins Into Climate Assets—And Why Oatly Moved In
additionalSources.quote: via Nativus Company Limited a part of China Resources (a conglomerate owned by the Chinese state)
